review: Request: Sol asked to test physically whether a small amount of an owned berry leaves a visible colored drawing on nearby ground and, if feasible, to draw a simple branching pattern, using at most one owned berry, a reachable surface and only genuinely acquired extra materials, keeping at least three berries as food and assuming no permanence, protection or wellbeing reward. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general operation to apply marking material, with an owned source stack, a reachable surface and local coordinates, a test or draw mode, a material budget, an optional acquired applicator and a bounded stroke path; the test must reuse the probe press (one round, 0.5 energy, 0.1 material) and be recorded as reuse; draw makes up to three strokes totalling at most 0.3 world units, each at most 0.2 energy, one round and 0.3 material; the reservation is atomic and never takes the source below the given floor (three of Sol's four berries); the surface lies within a 0.5 hand reach; the debit is conserved as surface deposit, hand residue and waste with no duplicated edible quantity; work persists at test and stroke boundaries, interruption stops contact, cancellation or death releases unused reservations without refunds; durability is reported as untested; rendering metadata shows only real deposits; no reward. Implemented: apply-marking-material@1 (scope long-ex20, from a reusable surfaceMarkingPackage(id, scope) factory in long-ex20-surface-marking.ts, registered last in V7_PACKAGES; one study round; the ability serializes to 3,380 code units). test checks before any charge an own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated stack, a budget of 0.1-1 in tenths, a source holding at least floor + budget, a ground point the person sees now within 0.5 of the body centre that is not water and not under a living body or a solid or reserved object, and 0.5 energy (a named applicator is refused because only hand contact is represented); it then calls the unchanged open.probe press at load 0.5 on the source, which charges its own 0.5 energy and 0.1 sample and records the load response, computes the contact transfer, opens a paid-work record (workCreate) and, only after a visible mark, reserves budget - 0.1 from the source through workAllocations and workReserve in the same atomic action; a failed transfer reserves nothing and completes the work. draw validates 1-3 strokes of 2-4 surface-local points (offsets from the test point), a total length of at most 0.3, 0.1-0.3 material each within the reserve, and every point and every 0.05 along it within reach, seen, on the tested ground type and still holding liquid; it emits a quote (stroke count, length, upper-bound energy, material and rounds), then pays one stroke per round through workPay (0.2 energy) and debits its material from the reserve, continuing each round; each stroke rechecks reach, surface, reserve, the source floor and energy, refusing with nothing spent before the first stroke and pausing at no charge afterwards; an unworked round pauses as an interruption, draw resumes the stored plan, a different plan is refused as a new attempt, and completion returns the unused reserve. cancel costs no energy and returns the unused reserve through workStop; death drops it at the body once; applied marks remain and nothing is refunded. Work, reserve and modes are owner-only: others cannot draw, cancel, eat or test with Sol's stacks. Effects and events: a non-solid, unreserved applied-mark object on the ground, created by the person and seen by nearby people through ordinary observation, with surface-local stroke geometry, deposit, colour, contrast, coverage, creation time and dated changes; the work record keeps the full debit split; events marking-tested, marking-draw-quoted, marking-stroke, marking-paused, marking-resumed, marking-interrupted, marking-completed, marking-cancelled and marking-ended (plus the probe's trial-result and trial-material-consumed and workPay's process-progress) carry actor, mode, source, reserve, surface reference, location, tick, measured outcome and view metadata with visible deposited portions only; verified personal records (openRemember) hold the observed test result and the drawn pattern with the ground and durability untested; branching is reported only where visible strokes meet with at least three arms. The viewer gains an applied-mark drawing that shows only visible deposits at their recorded colour, width and geometry and nothing for a failed or invisible transfer, and the forest canvas omits the generic shadow for this kind; existing drawings are unchanged. Modeling assumptions: (1) a sample pulps when the probe press does not hold (strength = hardness / 10 below the load 0.5) and its flexibility is 0, so berries pulp and hard or flexible materials release no liquid; (2) the liquid share is the stack's own water record, else the food water composition (berry 0.85, root 0.75), else the resource moisture property; (3) a quarter of the released liquid stays on the hand as residue and the rest reaches the ground, solids are waste, and an unpulped sample is wholly waste as the probe already consumes it; (4) firm forest floor, meadow or rocky ground with waterlogging at most 0.1 holds the liquid, a wet bank or waterlogged ground disperses it as waste, and water cells are not ground; (5) the liquid carries the material's represented colour (berry #b34f66), applied at opacity 0.6 times coverage over a ground tone taken from the observatory terrain palette (forest floor #52644a, meadow #7d8860, rocky #888b78, wet bank #596e61) because no other ground appearance is represented; contrast is the Euclidean RGB distance over its maximum, visible from 0.05, giving Sol's berry on forest floor #8c575b at contrast 0.14; (6) coverage = min(1, deposited mass / (area x 0.05)) with the resource mass per unit, a 0.02-radius test spot and 0.02-wide strokes; (7) visibility follows the world's light-independent perception; (8) no rain, smearing or fading rule exists, so the mark stays as applied and every record states durability untested and wetness not modelled after application; (9) unused reserved berries remain ordinary food under the world's tenths accounting. Conservation in Sol's case: the test debits 0.1 (deposit 0.06375, residue 0.02125, waste 0.015) and each 0.3 stroke deposits 0.19125, so a test plus three strokes costs four rounds, 1.1 energy and exactly one berry unit while the source stays at three; this was confirmed on the archived round-8 world with item-2-sol-16. Reuse: the unchanged open.probe press handler (recorded as reuse, not a new invention), openRemember, openConditions and openMaterial, the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers, the food water composition, collectiveFoodProfile and the tenths accounting; the expression mark and name signs (no physical effect), the ex16 branch-screen (an appearance-valued structure without a deposit) and the ex13 residue-transfer packages (non-food residue without colour) were checked and are not equivalent, and no earlier package deposits colour. No practice milestone (the practice evidence is the unqualified completion event), satisfaction source, reward, nutrition, protection or comfort is added. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and implementable as a simplified but real mechanism, the missing facts (pigment colour, ground colour, transfer share and durability) are covered by the recorded assumptions, and the applicator parameter is refused rather than simulated.
